name: shaft
description: Language intelligence, compiler diagnostics, formatting, and editing support for Shaft.

shaft.languageServer.compilerPath.description: Optional compiler executable. When empty, Shaft uses the compiler registered by install.py, then shaftc on PATH.

shaft.languageServer.diagnostics.description: When Shaft compiler diagnostics run. Structural diagnostics always update while typing.

shaft.languageServer.stdlibPath.description: Optional path to std.shaft passed to shaftc with --std.

shaft.languageServer.resourcePath.description: Optional Shaft resource directory passed to shaftc with --resources.

shaft.languageServer.maxProblems.description: Maximum Shaft diagnostics reported for one document.

shaft.format.insertFinalNewline.description: Append a trailing newline when formatting Shaft documents.

scripts.check: node --check extension.cjs && node --check server/shaft-lsp.cjs && node --check server/lib/shaft-language.cjs && node --test test/*.test.cjs
